newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FERC approves NGC Corp merger with Destec.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FERC approves NGC Corp merger with Destec.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Wednesday approved NGC Corp's proposed $1.3 billion acquisition of Destec Energy Inc .
With the FERC approval, company executives said earlier they expected the deal to close by July.
The merger will add to NGC's power portfolio $300 million in assets and 1,800 megawatts of domestic generation from 20 power plants centered largely in California and Texas.

After the merger closes, NGC plans to back Destec with about $50 million to $75 million in financing for worldwide power investments to expand its generating capacity for firm contract power sales and trading by NGC's power trading arm.
